title: Introducing Payment Times Analysis in Business Central (2023 release wave 2)

features.name: Payment Times Analysis
features.description: A new global feature that analyzes payment behavior against vendors and customers, tracking whether payments occur on or after due dates. Can be aggregated by company size or period.
caveats: Currently required for vendors only by authorities, but feature extended to include customers and both
Company size field must be specified on vendor cards

features.name: Aggregation by Company Size
features.description: Analysis option that groups payment data by company size categories, required by Swedish regulatory requirements for companies with 250 or more employees.
caveats: Company sizes must be specified on vendor cards to be included in the report

features.name: Aggregation by Period
features.description: Analysis option that groups payment data by custom periods defined in a payment periods table, allowing flexible period-based reporting for different regulatory requirements.
caveats: Periods must be configured in the payment periods table before generating reports

features.name: Payment Analysis Statistics
features.description: Statistics provided in payment analysis including average agreed payment period, average actual payment period, percentage paid on time, and optional amount-based analysis instead of invoice count.
caveats: Some countries may prefer amount-based analysis rather than invoice count

features.name: Payment Analysis Drill-Down
features.description: Ability to drill down into payment analysis details to see specific invoice and payment entries, dates, and amounts relating to each line item.

features.name: Historical Payment Data Storage
features.description: Payment analysis data is stored for historical purposes, allowing users to view historical payment data over time.

features.name: Payment Analysis Print Reports
features.description: Ability to print payment analysis reports with appropriate layout selected automatically.
